name: Shwarma Chicken Chickpea Sheet Pan
author: Payton Ayala
steps: Cut the chicken into cubes. Rinse the canned chickpeas.
Mix everything together and pour onto a parchment lined baking sheet. Cook at 375 until chicken is roasted through.
Seasonings can vary, no measurements. Just a crapton of seasoning. Like, coat it.
[optional] Sometimes I like to put tomato wedges in there too.
I serve with couscous that I've cooked in chicken broth, topped with feta and tzatziki. Naan bread, sliced mini cucumber and red onion on the side.
